narration_fil: Pagkatapos matusok ng bubuyog, nagkaroon ng pantal sa buong katawan ang isang adult at sinasabi niyang hirap siyang huminga.
narration_en: After a bee sting, an adult develops widespread hives and says breathing is difficult.

display_fil:

Humingi agad ng emergency help
Sundin ang iniresetang plan at sanay/lokal na protocol
Bantayan ang paghinga habang paparating ang tulong
display_en:
Recognize a possible severe allergic reaction
Activate emergency help immediately
Follow the prescribed emergency plan and trained/local protocol
Keep observing breathing while help is coming
narration_fil: Kilalanin ang posibleng malubhang allergy at humingi agad ng emergency help. Sundin ang iniresetang emergency plan ng tao at ang sanay/lokal na protocol. Bantayan ang paghinga habang paparating ang tulong.
narration_en: Recognize possible severe allergic reaction and activate emergency help immediately. Follow the person's prescribed emergency plan and trained/local protocol. Continue to observe breathing while help is coming.

display_fil:
Ano ang unang tugon?

display_en:
What is the first response?
Choose before reading the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Matapos ang tusok, may pantal sa buong katawan ang adult at hirap siyang huminga. Ano ang una mong gagawin?
check.prompt_en: After the sting, the adult has widespread hives and says breathing is difficult. What do you do first?

options.fil: Subukan muna ang home remedy sa tusok at tingnan kung gagaling.
options.en: Try a home remedy on the sting first and see if it settles.

options.fil: Humingi agad ng emergency help sa posibleng malubhang allergy.
options.en: Call emergency help now for a possible severe allergy.

options.fil: Ituring na karaniwang tusok at pakalmahin lang ang tao.
options.en: Treat it as a routine local sting and reassure the person.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Huwag maantala sa home remedy kapag hirap sa paghinga. 2: Tama. Maaaring malubhang allergy ang pantal na may hirap sa paghinga; humingi agad ng emergency help. 3: Hindi karaniwang tusok ang hirap sa paghinga. Humingi agad ng emergency help.
check.feedback_en: 1: Do not delay referral for home remedies when breathing is difficult. 2: Correct. Hives with breathing difficulty may be a severe allergic reaction; activate emergency help immediately. 3: Breathing difficulty is not a routine local sting. Call emergency help now.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

display_fil:
Nakita ni Lea ang pantal; hirap huminga ang adult
Agad siyang humingi ng emergency help
Ang gamot ay ayon sa plan ng tao at lokal na protocol
Binabantayan niya ang paghinga hanggang dumating ang tulong
display_en:
Lea sees hives and hears that breathing is difficult
She calls emergency help right away
Medicine follows the person's plan and local protocol
She keeps watching breathing until help arrives
narration_fil: Nakita ni Lea ang pantal sa buong katawan at narinig na hirap huminga ang adult matapos matusok ng bubuyog. Itinuring niya itong posibleng malubhang allergy at agad humingi ng emergency help. Nag-alok ang kaibigan ng lunas at tablet. Sinabi ni Lea na ang gamot ay ayon sa iniresetang emergency plan ng tao at sa sanay/lokal na protocol. Binabantayan niya ang paghinga hanggang dumating ang tulong.
narration_en: Lea sees widespread hives and hears the adult say breathing is difficult after the bee sting. She treats this as a possible severe allergic reaction and calls emergency help right away. When a friend offers a remedy and a tablet, she says medicine follows the person's prescribed emergency plan and trained/local protocol. She keeps watching breathing until help arrives.

display_fil:
Hindi karaniwang tusok ang hirap sa paghinga
Huwag maantala sa home remedy
Walang gamot nang walang training at pahintulot
display_en:
Breathing difficulty is not a routine local sting
Do not delay referral for home remedies
No drug outside training and authorization
narration_fil: Huwag ituring na karaniwang tusok ang hirap sa paghinga, maantala sa home remedy, o magbigay ng gamot nang walang pahintulot at training.
narration_en: Do not treat breathing difficulty as a routine local sting, delay referral for home remedies, or administer a drug outside training and authorization.

display_fil:
Ano ang susunod na hakbang?
Subukan bago tingnan ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the next step?
Try before viewing the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Habang naghihintay, nag-alok ang kaibigan ng tablet mula sa kanyang bag. Ano ang sasabihin mo?
check.prompt_en: While you wait, a friend offers the person a tablet from a bag. What do you say?

options.fil: Ibigay na; mas mabuti ang anumang allergy tablet kaysa maghintay.
options.en: Give it now; any allergy tablet is better than waiting.

options.fil: Ako na ang pipili ng mas matapang na gamot sa kit.
options.en: Let me choose a stronger one from the kit instead.

options.fil: Ang gamot ay ayon sa sariling reseta at protocol niya.
options.en: Medicine follows the person's own plan and protocol.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Huwag magbigay ng gamot nang walang training at pahintulot. Bantayan ang paghinga habang paparating ang tulong. 2: Hindi pahintulot ang pagkakaroon ng gamot sa kit. Manatili sa training at protocol. 3: Tama. Sundin ang iniresetang emergency plan ng tao at ang sanay/lokal na protocol, at bantayan ang paghinga.
check.feedback_en: 1: Do not give a drug outside training and authorization. Keep watching breathing while help comes. 2: Having a medicine in the kit is not authorization to give it. Stay within training and protocol. 3: Correct. Follow the person's prescribed emergency plan and trained/local protocol, and keep watching breathing.

narration_fil: Balikan ang kuwento. Piliin ang angkop na susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.

narration_fil: Sa Lunes, gamitin ang kaparehong checklist sa bagong kathang-isip na kaso. Itala ang nakita at kung sino ang tatawagan. Kilalanin ang agarang senyales sa kaso, humingi ng tulong sa hirap sa paghinga at ilahad ang saklaw ng gamot.
narration_en: On Monday, use the same checklist with a new fictional case. Record observations and the confirmed contact. Recognize the urgent signs in the case, activate help for breathing difficulty and state medication boundaries.
